title: Early-fit seasonal models left late Nino 3.4 cooling imbalance unusual with bootstrap refits in 1988-2025
abstract: We fit seasonal linear models to Nino 3.4 temperatures in 1950-1987 and tested six-month change imbalance in 1988-2025. We used a fixed NOAA ERSSTv5 source. The late cubic change statistic was -0.6424. The primary model used two months of memory and calendar-month residual draws. Its bootstrap-refit central 95% range was -0.3712 to 0.4147; the absolute-tail fraction was 0.0030. We report fixed fits and a six-month memory check. The test adds an early-fit split and bootstrap refits to prior full-record model checks. It does not give independent confirmation because prior work selected the pattern on the full record. Short early samples, model error, revised source data and approximate bootstrap uncertainty limit the result. Code, all scalar draws, source hashes and a figure are included. Monthly source data remain external.

display.caption: Late statistic and model output ranges, with variance diagnostics. Ranges describe simulations, not confidence limits on observations.
